title: The Argent Shaker
description: A thick, rounded silver lava rock ring with a loose prong setting — the rock shakes when moved. Inspired by the horns visible in the final bossfight of Hollow Knight.

title: The Sedentary Liver
description: A large silver signet ring depicting one of my dogs, Tucker, asleep. Made from a flat silver sheet and stained with acid for contrast. Highly polished and reflective — one of my favorite pieces.

title: The Ethereal Ouroboros
description: Multiple people asked me for a small dainty ring made out of brass, so I made a few. They don't take long to make, but they are very low quality. Brass is not a great material, unfortunately.

title: The Verdant Crag
description: One time I decided to make my sister a birthday gift, and this is what it was. It contains a quartz rock from her trip to Mexico, and the band features a leaf design, as requested.

title: The Clandestine Assemblage
description: This was an upgrade to the first simple ring I made. It uses an extra thick piece of brass. The outside truly was polished a lot, but the jewelry guard covers that up. The edges are not sanded.

title: The Ameliorated Morsel
description: I had heard about inlay rings, and I wanted to test them out, but only quickly without too much effort. This resulted in me using scrap metal, so the result looks really bad. Personally, I do not hate it as much as it looks bad.

title: The Coral Bauble

images.alt: Silver signet ring with pink rock

description: For Christmas, I made my mother a silver signet ring with a pink gemstone bezel set on top. Personally, I think this thing looks fantastic.

title: The Fallen Watcher
description: A bent copper bookmark showing a skeleton staring at a bee nest on a tree. Texturing plays a major role, emphasizing the depth of the shapes and the scene's mood.

title: The Trembling Shruber
description: A frog-shaped textured brass keychain inspired by this photo. My very first project — and still one of the coolest to me.

title: The Perpetual Perspicacity
description: As part of my first lost wax casting, I made a spider. Although a few limbs did not fully attach, I was able to replace them. I really like how this guy turned out.

title: The Anamnestic Arbol
description: As part of my first lost wax casting assignment, I replicated The Persistence of Memory by Salvador Dalí. It was supposed to be a charm to help me be more efficient with my time.

title: The Exuviating Polliwog

images.alt: Small silver frog from left view
Small silver frog from right view

description: As part of jewelry II, we had to make two additional lost wax castings, one out of soft wax, one out of hard wax. This was the soft wax one and I made it for a MTG croak counter.

title: The Fathomless Ward
description: I wanted to make a special card holder for a MTG commander, so I made this. It works as intended and it is pretty nice.

title: The Sterling Lagomorph
description: I made a small silver cast rabbit for my sister at Christmas. She likes bunnies, so I made one for her.

title: The Revolving Aureole

images.alt: A spinning ring, in full form
A spinning ring, on the ground

description: I wanted to make this, because I thought it would be epic. I wanted to have something to play with in class, because class can be boring, and spinning rings are fun. I was sort of inspired by the time turner from Harry Potter, but I did come up with most of this on my own.

title: The Crimson Poltroon

images.alt: Large chicken ring with ruby set, front view
Large chicken ring with ruby set, left view
Large chicken ring with ruby set, right view
Large chicken ring with ruby set, side view

description: For my grandmother, I made a silver chicken ring with a ruby in a prong setting. She loves chickens so I made the entire ring into a chicken sitting on your finger. In front and behind the chicken are two roses, because they are my grandmother's favorite flower. Her birthstone is a ruby, so there is a large ruby prong set in the center of the chicken. This was carved out of hard wax and taught me patience.
